explanation: The proof relies on the library's own LinearMap.BilinForm.exists_finset_forall_exists_toMatrix_mem (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/FiniteClasses.lean). A grep of Mathlib found no declaration with that name. A search of Mathlib for Gram-matrix, reduction-theory and finiteness-of-positive-definite-forms results found only unrelated inner-product-space files. IntegralLattice is not a Mathlib notion, so I found no matching finiteness statement for integral lattices of bounded determinant.
